units.source_text: 金钟儿是千重子放进壶里的，可是紫花地丁是怎样到如此狭窄的小天地来的呢？

en.t: Chieko had put the bell crickets into the jar, but how had the violets come into such a narrow little world?

units.source_text: 今年紫花地丁开花了，金钟儿想必也会出生、鸣叫的。

en.t: This year the violets had bloomed, and surely the bell crickets too would be born and begin to sing.
